title: 基于弱监督与LLM标签精炼的被迫流离失所与FCV文档数据集提及抽取框架
summary: 提出弱监督框架，利用轻量模型从无标注领域文档中生成候选数据集提及，再由前沿LLM在上下文中审核、修正边界，并结合合成与对比样本微调模型。在1706段基准上达到74.1%精确率、70.5%召回率，含引用段落精确率达89.5%。
summary_en: A weakly supervised framework adapts dataset extraction to forced displacement and FCV documents without large manual labels. A lightweight model generates candidate mentions from unlabeled domain text, which a frontier LLM reviews and corrects, with synthetic and contrastive examples used for fine-tuning. On a 1,706-passage benchmark it achieves 74.1% precision and 70.5% recall at mention level, and 89.5% precision among passages containing dataset references.
